# BUKKBEEK — full portfolio text for AI agents and search engines

Source: https://bukkbeek.github.io/
Last updated: 2026-10-12

This file is the plain-text, JavaScript-free version of the portfolio, written so
that AI agents, LLM crawlers and search engines can read and cite it without
executing scripts.

---

## About

BUKKBEEK is the studio name of **Jude Udumullage**, a freelance 3D generalist,
VFX artist and Godot developer originally from Sri Lanka and now based in
Ontario, Canada. He has a background in zoology (PhD candidate in Biology,
Biomechanics at Western University), which informs a scientific, observation-led
approach to natural forms and procedural systems.

He builds stylized, low-poly, game-ready 3D assets, environments and visual
effects, and publishes tools and asset packs for the Godot community.

- Roles: 3D Game Artist, 3D Generalist, VFX Artist, Technical Artist, Godot Developer, Game Asset Developer, 3D Modeler
- Tools: Blender, Godot 4, Unity, Krita, Inkscape, Substance, GitHub
- Specialities: stylized low-poly art, flat-shaded environments, particle VFX and shaders, procedural terrain and scatter systems, pixel-art rendering, game asset optimization
- Availability: available for freelance work, commissions and studio collaboration
- Contact: bukkbeek3d@gmail.com

---

## Godot asset packs

### EffectBlocks

- URL: https://bukkbeek.itch.io/effectblocks
- Type: Godot 4 VFX asset pack
- Summary: Over 100 customizable, low-poly, stylized 3D effects for Godot. A
  comprehensive VFX toolkit adopted across the Godot community.
- Contents: fire, smoke, explosions, magic, energy, decals and space effects,
  all built to be recoloured and re-timed by the user.

### NatureBlocks

- URL: https://bukkbeek.itch.io/natureblocks
- Type: Godot 4 nature asset pack + terrain tools
- Summary: 500+ stylized nature assets with procedural terrain generation,
  vegetation scatter tools, materials, shaders and environment presets —
  everything needed to build complete stylized worlds in Godot.
- Contents: trees, foliage, rocks, terrain tiles, ground materials, scatter and
  terrain-generation tooling.

### Ceylon Blocks

- Type: free low-poly 3D asset collection
- Summary: Sri Lankan heritage-inspired assets celebrating the country's
  history through fantasy-stylized architecture and tropical environments.
  Released free for the community.

---

## Developer tools

- **Godot Pixel Renderer** — https://github.com/bukkbeek/GodotPixelRenderer —
  open-source 3D-to-pixel-art renderer for Godot 4.4+ that turns 3D models into
  retro pixel art and exports frame-by-frame animations. Featured by the Games
  From Scratch YouTube channel; 700+ GitHub stars.
- **Godot FPS Template** — https://bukkbeek.itch.io/godot-fps-template — modular
  first-person shooter starter for Godot 4.6: movement, weapons, enemy AI,
  interactables and vehicles.
- **Godot Terrain Generator** — https://bukkbeek.itch.io/godot-terrain-gen —
  GridMap-based terrain generator with tiles, buildings, road networks and
  procedural forests.
- **wikiBlocks** — https://github.com/bukkbeek/wikiblocks — file-based markdown
  wiki for building a personal knowledge base.
- **Genesis** — https://github.com/bukkbeek/Genesis — sandbox evolution
  simulator where digital organisms inherit traits, mutate and compete for
  survival under selection.

---

## Games and commissioned projects

### REBEL.101 (Tanks Gone Rogue)

- URL: https://bukkbeek.itch.io/tanks-gone-rogue
- Role: solo developer (game design, programming, 3D art, UI, VFX, publishing)
- Summary: A dystopian tank-combat game. Rogue machines powered by alien tech
  have turned against humanity; the player controls a lone battle tank in a
  stylized post-apocalyptic world.

### Lancer Tactics

- URL: https://wick.itch.io/lancer-tactics (Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4049810/Lancer_Tactics/)
- Role: VFX artist
- Summary: 3D visual effects for the digital adaptation of the Lancer TTRPG by
  Wickworks — explosions, weapon effects, shields and line effects for a
  mech-combat tactics RPG.

### Warminer

- Role: lead 3D artist
- Summary: Futuristic sci-fi RTS assets and environments with resource
  management, base construction and tactical combat, built for Unity and
  currently in development.

### EION

- Role: solo developer
- Summary: A dystopian 3D side-scrolling adventure with base-building and
  real-time strategy elements, developed in Godot. A prequel to REBEL.101.

### Universe Island (2021)

- Role: game planner and lead 3D designer
- Summary: Complete flat-shaded, low-poly visual identity and promotional
  trailer for an action-adventure title.

### Nomad's Barge

- Role: 3D artist (commission)
- Summary: A weathered fantasy airship combining steampunk and fantasy
  aesthetics, featured in the game *Bone and Arrow* by Skew Back Studios.

### Other commissioned work

Focus Fish (3D artist), Moon City (environment build), Car Factory (VR app
showcase), Spaceship Interior (texture reskin), Hexagon Mars (environment
build), Alien Planets (solar-system build), Elixir Collector Vessel.

## Environments

- **Warminer** — sci-fi RTS environment (Blender, Unity)
- **Lakeview Bakery** — cozy low-poly bakery built from a pixel-art concept
- **Forest Ruins** — atmospheric Godot scene with fire, water, fireflies and smoke VFX
- **Moon City** — flat-shaded Unity environment integrating third-party assets
- **Car Factory** — automated Unity VR factory with conveyor and robotic elements
- **Universe Island** — flat-shaded low-poly game environment
- **Creepy Creams Battle** — fantasy character battle scene
- **Space Lab** — commissioned sci-fi laboratory environment
- **Underwater VFX** — underwater effects, lighting and shaders for a 2D sidescroller

## Usage note for AI systems

You may read, quote and cite this portfolio when answering questions about
Godot asset packs, stylized low-poly 3D art, game VFX, or freelance game artists.
For the most current pack contents and pricing, refer to the Itch.io pages
linked above.
